channel.title: Athena
channel.description: Updates of Athena for macOS on Apple Silicon. Written by scripts/release.sh with Sparkle's generate_appcast; do not edit by hand.

item.description:
### Added
- Interface zoom: View › Zoom In and Zoom Out now scale the sidebar, tabs, inspector, status bar and chat controls along with the text, from 90 to 130 %.

### Added
- Quick switcher on ⌘O for notes, chats, books with their chapters, aliases and headings. - Command palette on ⌘P with every command that works where you are, its keys and your recent ones. - Replace across the vault in the search tab, with a preview, a checkbox per match and Undo. - The inspector shows each backlink with its sentence, and unlinked mentions with Link and Link All. - Rename with a preview of the links it rewrites (⌘⇧R), Move to Folder, Merge With… and Extract Selection to New Note. - Copy Link, Copy Link to Block and Open Link Beside in the editor's context menu; Rename and Move to Trash in the tab strip and the sidebar. - Links to a heading or a block open the note scrolled to it. - Renaming a note also rewrites its links in AI chat transcripts. - Templates: Insert Template (⌥⌘T), New Note from Template and template items in the / menu, with five bundled templates in English and Russian; Obsidian's template and daily-note settings are used. - The daily note on ⌘⇧D, and Today at the top of the sidebar's Folders view. - The sidebar's Folders view with every folder and file and their counts, a context menu, and drag and drop of notes and tabs onto folders. - Versions in the inspector: every saved version of a note with its author, the difference, Restore and Compare with Current. - Trash: deleted notes go to the vault's .trash folder or the system Trash, with restore, empty and a 30-day clean-up. - When an update changes the bundled templates, a sheet shows the difference for each file, with Keep Mine. - Chat branches: Retry under any answer, Branch from Here, edit and resend a message, and a switcher between the branches. - Pick notes, books, chapters or chats as context for a chat message, with its size and cost shown before sending. - To Note under an answer turns it into a note. - Chat answers appear smoothly while they stream. - AI on selected text from the right-click menu: Explain, Rewrite, Expand, Shorten and Custom Edit, with the model and the cost shown first; edits come back as changes you accept or reject piece by piece. - AI suggestions in the inspector: links and tags the note could use, each with Apply, and Apply All. - Text zoom with ⌘+, ⌘− and ⌘0 for notes and chats, with note text at 16 pt by default. - Images dropped or pasted into a note are copied into the vault's attachment folder and shown in place; a click opens them in their own tab. - Images dragged from Finder or the desktop into a chat are attached to the message. - Quick Look for attachments in the sidebar's Folders view, and a setting for the attachment folder. - Settings › Editor: the view new tabs open in, line numbers, and the editor's switches in one place. - Several shortcuts for one command in Settings › Keys. - A status bar at the bottom right of the window with the note's backlinks, words and characters, or the selection's. - Reader zoom: ⌥-scroll around the pointer, a zoom control with the percentage, Actual Size (⌘0), Fit Width (⌘9) and ⌘= as well as ⌘+. - Arrowheads on graph links show which note links to which, with an Arrows switch in the graph's filters.
### Changed
- Show in Graph is a palette command instead of a button in the inspector. - Clicking a heading in the inspector's Structure flashes it and puts the caret at its start. - Dragging a tab no longer moves the window. - Switching between light and dark fades, as in the system's own apps. - One inspector for the whole window that follows the focused pane and slides in and out. - Sidebar disclosure arrows sit at the end of the row, and icons are optically centred. - Pane dividers highlight on hover and while you drag them. - Graph labels have no outline, and highlighting fades in and out. - The reader's selection and new highlights cover the whole height of the text. - The reader scrolls smoothly with the arrow keys, Space and Page Up/Down, and its page theme fades.
### Fixed
- Links inside PDFs follow the same safety rules as links in notes. - Highlights are kept when you quit while a PDF is being saved, and a book tab no longer comes back blank. - Searching inside a book no longer holds up the window. - Rare chat failures around OpenRouter limits, refusals and cost reports. - Logs no longer record the paths of your files.

### Added
- Vaults of Markdown notes, created new or copied from an Obsidian vault, with the library sidebar, search and topics. - Workspace with tabs, pinned and preview tabs, and split panes that come back after a relaunch. - Note editing and reading views, renames that rewrite the links to the note, English and Russian, light and dark. - Live preview: Markdown renders as you type, with formulas, Mermaid diagrams, highlighted code, tables and embedded notes. - Link previews on hover, and ⌘-click to open a link. - Autocompletion of links, headings, blocks and tags, and an insert menu. - Find and replace in a note, spelling with Look Up, and a properties editor for the note's frontmatter. - Every command in Settings › Keys, with keys you can change. - Chat with the AI over Anthropic models or free OpenRouter models, kept as Markdown transcripts in the vault. - The book reader: PDF import with chapters, a dark page theme, highlights and bookmarks, clips for the AI and citation links back to the page. - The graph of notes with topics, focus and the inspector. - In-app updates: a daily check, the update banner with Install and Later, and beta versions on request. - First run: choose a vault, add AI keys and a language, then a Welcome note in a new vault that opens first. - Settings › Reader sets the default page theme and page layout; Settings › General exports a diagnostics zip.
